title: Agent Skill evaluation cases
description: Schema for per-skill evaluation cases, following the Agent Skills specification's `evals/evals.json` convention (https://agentskills.io). Each case is run twice — once with the skill attached and once without — so the skill's contribution is measurable rather than assumed.

skill_name.description: Must match the skill's `name` frontmatter field and its directory name.

evals.description: Test cases. At least three are recommended; include at least one near-miss that must NOT trigger this skill.

prompt.description: A realistic user message — the way someone would actually type it. Include real file paths, column names and personal context.

expected_output.description: Human-readable description of what success looks like. This is the rubric the grader checks against.

files.description: Input files the skill needs, relative to the skill's evals/ directory.

type.description: should_trigger: the skill must load. should_not_trigger: it must NOT (use for near-misses). output_contains: the response must contain a given string. behavior: a free-form behavioural expectation.

value.description: The expected value: true/false for trigger assertions, a string for output_contains.

requires.description: External requirements for the case to run.
